title: catalog.product.changed — Payload Schema
description: Incremental change notification emitted by erp.catalog when a product is created or modified. This message does NOT carry the full product state. Consumers must re-fetch the complete product using the snapshot or on-demand, depending on their indexing strategy. For product deletions, see catalog.product.tombstone.

product_id.description: Stable product identifier from ERP Core. Never reused after deletion.

product_version.description: Monotonically increasing version counter per product_id. Consumers must discard any message where product_version is less than or equal to the last processed version for this product_id. This is the primary idempotency mechanism.

operation.description: upsert: the product was created or its data changed — consumers should re-index it. unpublish: the product must be hidden from the storefront but its record is preserved in the consumer index. For permanent deletions, erp.catalog emits catalog.product.tombstone instead.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the change was committed in ERP Core. Generated by the transactional outbox (ADR-002), not by the consumer.
